results.title: North Union wins girls portion of cross country races held during invitational at Fairbanks
results.description: The annual “Farm”banks High School cross country invitational was held on a hot and humid Tuesday evening. It was hosted by the Fairbanks Panthers. FHS hosted North Union, Marion Harding and Columbus Wellington. North Union captured top team honors in the girls meet with 21 points. -- Ava Lahmers, above, of Fairbanks, and Felix Plouck, below, of North Union respectively placed first and third in the girls and boys races on Tuesday evening during the annual “Farm”banks Invitational that was held at Fairbanks High School. (Journal-Tribune photos by Tim Miller) -- Fairbanks was the runner-up with 50 and Wellington finished with 51. Marion Harding won the boys meet with 26 points, followed by North Union-45 and Fairbanks-54. The boys and girls races were reduced from a 5K to a two-mile event, due to the ongoing construction at Fairbanks High School.
